title: Robot seized by German police after allegedly groping teenage girl
key_facts: German police have launched an investigation into two teenagers accused of controlling a robot that allegedly groped a 16-year-old girl.
Police in Cologne confiscated the red and gold robot, about 120 cm (3.9 ft) tall, which allegedly grabbed the girl's buttocks and made thrusting motions before she screamed and moved away.
It happened close to midnight local time on Saturday (10 Oct 2026) in front of a fast-food outlet near the city centre, while the girl was with friends.
North Rhine-Westphalia police say the robot's 16-year-old owner and his 19-year-old companion are believed to have streamed the incident live on social media and commented on it.
Officers found the boy and the man a block away; the robot was in the back of a car. Police also seized two mobile phones.
Police are trying to determine whether someone was deliberately controlling the robot's movements at the time.
In a follow-up Facebook post, police warned that some social media comments on the case can cross the line and, in the worst case, be a criminal offence.
